shared_elements: symmetrical arrangement of paired curved lines
abstracted anthropomorphic reference (figure or figure-like design)
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, outline-only carved motifs built from curved lines with a roughly bilateral symmetry, and both include circular/ring elements set within or beside those curves, which is the most concrete correspondence. However, A shows a single small isolated figure-like design with radiating limb-like strokes floating on an otherwise empty rock face, while B is a large three-dimensional human figure whose back is covered by an organised composition of stacked bands, paired spirals/rings and a girdle-like arc — a far more structured and hierarchical scheme with no counterpart in A.
